wood_tile.note: the boards: the grain runs across

vellum_tile.note: the window, the slots, the card

board_frame.note: every board: the dark outline, a carved line round it, iron rivets at the corners. Lay a top-to-bottom shade over the wood first (rgba(255,230,180,0.08) to rgba(0,0,0,0.20))

card_frame.note: the recipe card and any light panel on a board

plate_frame.note: the picture of the thing on the card: a double ink line

button.note: the Craft button: text in the heading face, cream, centred

button_hover.note: the Craft button: text in the heading face, cream, centred

button_down.note: the Craft button: text in the heading face, cream, centred

list_bar.note: the chosen line in a list on the dark

window_back.note: behind the hero: the hero drawn with his feet at (65, 254) in this picture, at 0.62 of his render (his sheet frame at 1x times 1.24)

slot_round.note: a Gear slot: 40 px across; the icon drawn at 0.86 of it, centred

slot_round_chosen.note: over a chosen or hovered Gear slot

sketch_head.note: an empty head slot: a sepia ink sketch of what goes there, drawn over slot_round

sketch_chest.note: an empty chest slot: a sepia ink sketch of what goes there, drawn over slot_round

sketch_armour.note: an empty armour slot: a sepia ink sketch of what goes there, drawn over slot_round

sketch_trinket.note: an empty trinket slot: a sepia ink sketch of what goes there, drawn over slot_round

socket.note: a bag cell, 42 px, 47 px apart; the icon at 38 px; the count in the heading face, 13 px, cream, outlined 3 px in #1d120b, bottom right; the bar row numbered top left in ochre

capital_box.note: a heading's first letter: in this square, rubric red #9e3326, the heading face at 25 px; the rest of the word cream #f0e3c4 at 20 px beside it, 4 px after the square

tab_on.note: a tab down the left edge of a board, the word turned up the tab in the heading face, 12 px, cream

tab_off.note: a tab down the left edge of a board, the word turned up the tab in the heading face, 12 px, cream

rivet.note: already in board_frame; for other boards

board_frame_gilt.note: Robin's pick: the dark outline and two thin gilt lines inside it, no rivets. Lay the board shade over the wood first

slot_square.note: Robin's pick for the Gear slots: a 40 px dark square with a bronze rim (centred in 48); the icon at 0.86 of 40, centred

slot_square_chosen.note: over a chosen or hovered Gear slot: pale gold

socket_chosen_gold.note: over the chosen bag cell: pale gold

list_bar_gold.note: the chosen line in the recipe list: pale gold

sketch_light_head.note: an empty head slot on a dark square slot: the sketch in a pale sepia

sketch_light_chest.note: an empty chest slot on a dark square slot: the sketch in a pale sepia

sketch_light_armour.note: an empty armour slot on a dark square slot: the sketch in a pale sepia

sketch_light_trinket.note: an empty trinket slot on a dark square slot: the sketch in a pale sepia

flap_on.note: the chosen tab: red leather, a pale gold line, 66 by 38; hangs from under the Gear board (drawn before it, its top 8 px under the board's foot), 74 apart from x 46; the word in the heading face, bold 13, centred 11 px above its foot, cream

flap_off.note: a tab not chosen: dark oak, a faint gilt line, 66 by 30; hangs from under the Gear board (drawn before it, its top 8 px under the board's foot), 74 apart from x 46; the word in the heading face, bold 13, centred 9 px above its foot, #cdb98f

cost_socket.note: a material in a recipe's cost: 36 px, 46 apart, under a thin rule at the card's foot; the icon at 32; the number needed, bold 14, bottom right, cream with a 3 px #1d120b outline, #e0604c when you have too few; no 'Needs' and no 'of 25'

plaque.note: Robin's pick for every heading (Kol, Bag, Crafting, and the other boards'): a dark plank plaque with a pale gold line. 9-slice, inset 9; as wide as the word plus 15 px each side, 32 tall; its top-left 20 px in from the board's corner (the gilt lines' inside); the word in the heading face, bold 18, cream, centred

stat_heart.note: the picture beside Health on the Stats page: pale sepia ink, drawn about 11 px across, centred 9 px in from the line's left. Damage, An arrow, Chop, Mine and Cut use the weapon and tool icons instead (sword, bow, axe, pick, knife).

stat_wind.note: the picture beside Stamina on the Stats page: pale sepia ink, drawn about 11 px across, centred 9 px in from the line's left. Damage, An arrow, Chop, Mine and Cut use the weapon and tool icons instead (sword, bow, axe, pick, knife).

stat_return.note: the picture beside Stamina returns on the Stats page: pale sepia ink, drawn about 11 px across, centred 9 px in from the line's left. Damage, An arrow, Chop, Mine and Cut use the weapon and tool icons instead (sword, bow, axe, pick, knife).

stat_star.note: the picture beside Crit chance on the Stats page: pale sepia ink, drawn about 11 px across, centred 9 px in from the line's left. Damage, An arrow, Chop, Mine and Cut use the weapon and tool icons instead (sword, bow, axe, pick, knife).

stat_burst.note: the picture beside Crit damage on the Stats page: pale sepia ink, drawn about 11 px across, centred 9 px in from the line's left. Damage, An arrow, Chop, Mine and Cut use the weapon and tool icons instead (sword, bow, axe, pick, knife).

stat_shield.note: the picture beside Defense on the Stats page: pale sepia ink, drawn about 11 px across, centred 9 px in from the line's left. Damage, An arrow, Chop, Mine and Cut use the weapon and tool icons instead (sword, bow, axe, pick, knife).

stat_guard.note: the picture beside Guard on the Stats page: pale sepia ink, drawn about 11 px across, centred 9 px in from the line's left. Damage, An arrow, Chop, Mine and Cut use the weapon and tool icons instead (sword, bow, axe, pick, knife).

stat_boot.note: the picture beside Walk on the Stats page: pale sepia ink, drawn about 11 px across, centred 9 px in from the line's left. Damage, An arrow, Chop, Mine and Cut use the weapon and tool icons instead (sword, bow, axe, pick, knife).

portrait_ring.note: over his face at the Stats page's top right: the face is the kit as he is dressed, idle, facing south, frame 0, clipped to a circle of radius 24 on vellum, the crop 40 by 40 sheet px from (anchor.x - 29, anchor.y - 105), drawn at 54 px; the ring's centre 48 px in from the board's right edge and 40 below its top

flap_top_on.note: the chosen tab across the top of the Building board: red leather, a pale gold line, 38 tall; 9-slice, inset 16, as wide as the word plus 28; drawn before the board with its foot 8 px under the board's top edge, from x 20 in from the board's left, 6 apart; the word bold 13, centred, its baseline 22 px under the flap's top, cream

flap_top_off.note: a tab across the top of the Building board, not chosen: dark oak, a faint gilt line, 30 tall; 9-slice, inset 16, as wide as the word plus 28; drawn before the board with its foot 8 px under the board's top edge, from x 20 in from the board's left, 6 apart; the word bold 13, centred, its baseline 18 px under the flap's top, #d8c49c

flap_left_on.note: the chosen station tab off the crafting board's left edge (By hand, Workbench, Hearth): red leather, a pale gold line, 30 wide; 9-slice, inset 14, as tall as the word plus 24; drawn before the board with its right 6 px under the board's left edge, the first 24 px under the board's top, 6 apart; the word bold 13 turned up the flap, centred, cream. In place of tab_on and tab_off

flap_left_off.note: a station tab not chosen: dark oak, a faint gilt line, 24 wide; 9-slice, inset 14, as tall as the word plus 24; drawn before the board with its right 6 px under the board's left edge, the first 24 px under the board's top, 6 apart; the word bold 13 turned up the flap, centred, #d8c49c. In place of tab_on and tab_off

build_cell.note: a cell of the Building board: 9-slice, inset 10, 105 by 126 at a pitch of 111 by 132 (the board's 37 by 44 units); the piece's picture in the upper 70, its name regular 13 cream centred under it, its cost under that as a small icon and a bold 12 number (the cost red #e0604c when short, the whole cell at 45% when it cannot be paid). In place of the painted tile

build_cell_chosen.note: over the chosen or hovered Building cell: pale gold, 9-slice inset 8, drawn at the cell's size

pin_on.note: a pinned recipe: the pin turned, its head gold; at the plate’s top right corner (centre cx + 231, cy + 26) and on each slip (w - 18, 16); a click lets it go

pin_off.note: a recipe not pinned: the pin upright, dull bronze, at the plate’s top right corner; a click pins it (up to three)
